svg.title: Same synthetic array, different recorded Z spacing
svg.desc: All three synthetic planes have identical samples in source and changed export. Recorded Z spacing doubles from 1.5 to 3 micrometres. Rulers use a common zero-to-six micrometre scale; zero is chosen for relative centers. Thumbnail height does not depict plane thickness. Reticle compares metadata; fixture generation separately checks pixel equality.

g.text: Relative Z: zero chosen. No slice thickness depicted.
Relative Z: zero chosen. No slice thickness depicted.
Ordinary TIFF: Z lost, mapping unverified.
The mixed batch retains all pairs, exit 2.
Synthetic metadata evidence, not calibration truth.
